message:
Actually, Andrew, I think the above screed qualifies as flinging poo at the article, so yeah, I probably should be more charitable :-). Certainly, I shouldn't confuse Hu's perspective with those she reports on, but still, she fails in fundamental ways to interrogate the perspectives and sources on which she reports, as Jenny's response points out particularly well.

I found the implied classism troubling, as well: apparently, computers are certainly good for rich kids to use "to create the George Lucas and Steve Jobs of the future," but perhaps not so much for those less privileged.
